answer: Every attestation is a zenith signed by an established key and backed by 10 locked meadow, forfeited if the attested key is later slashed. The trellis records who signed for whom and grafts any keys sharing a signer onto one branch. The n-th key on a branch votes only with n zeniths from signers on other branches. A lone newcomer needs one zenith and 10 meadow. An operator grafting 100 clones needs 5,050 outside zeniths with 50,500 meadow at risk, or must recruit fresh unrelated signers for every clone.
